A '''research facility''' served the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]] in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It was [[Battle at the Republic research facility|assaulted]] by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].
